text:
On a warm day, a driver checks the air pressure in a car tyre. At night, the temperature drops and
the air pressure in the tyre decreases. There are no air leaks in the tyre.
Why does the pressure decrease?
A
The air molecules in the tyre move more slowly.
B
The air molecules in the tyre stop moving.
C
The volume of the air in the tyre decreases.
D
The volume of the air in the tyre increases.

options.label: A
options.text: The air molecules in the tyre move more slowly.

options.label: B
options.text: The air molecules in the tyre stop moving.

options.label: C
options.text: The volume of the air in the tyre decreases.

options.label: D
options.text: The volume of the air in the tyre increases.
